_comment: CURATOR-OWNED INPUT (Addendum A.2 Tier 2, A.8). This file is an editorial artifact, not a generated one. Ingestion VALIDATES this metadata against the corpus; it must never DECIDE it. The generated counterpart is build/<brand>/document-manifest.json, which ingestion writes.
corpus_status_note: Development/test corpus assembled by Autovision Studios from publicly available IAC/PFA material for pipeline validation. Supersession, authority and precedence relationships below are RECORDED AS OBSERVED, not decided by Autovision. The Ferrari Judging Committee supplies and approves the production corpus (A.8).

documents.redistribution_basis: Publicly published IAC/PFA judging guidelines. Development corpus only; Committee confirmation pending.
documents.display_description: IAC/PFA concours judging guidelines covering judging philosophy, team structure, the 100-point scoring basis, deduction range, award thresholds, and eligibility of replacement and safety items.
documents.notes: Establishes the 100-point start and the 0-5 point per-component deduction range at judge discretion. Foundational to the deduction presentation model in Addendum A.1.

documents.redistribution_basis: Publicly available IAC/PFA model checklist. Development corpus only; Committee confirmation pending.

declared_cross_references.note: Checklist line items carry trailing page numbers that index into the As-Built document. Page attribution depends on the referenced version being exactly 8.0.

documents.display_description: Observation checklist of major Exterior, Interior, and Engine and Chassis items reviewed when a 330 GTC or GTS is judged in an IAC/PFA concours. Each item carries a reference page number into the As-Built document.
documents.notes: Establishes what is CORRECT for a component. Attaches no point value - see Addendum A.1.

documents.display_title: 330 GTC/GTS As-Built Configuration, Authenticity, and Judging Notes
documents.redistribution_basis: Stated by the 330 GTC/GTS Concours Judging Checklist to be readable and downloadable from IACPFA.org. Development corpus only; Committee confirmation pending.
documents.display_description: Photographic and descriptive reference to how 330 GTC and GTS cars were originally built, covering exterior, interior, and engine and chassis configuration, authenticity, and judging notes.
documents.notes: Large image-heavy document. Exceeds the page-slice delivery threshold; slices required per Addendum A.7.
